UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.title: Keyboard Events Key Changes Mode
UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.description: If defined, this value causes ux_host_class_hid_keyboard_key_get to only report key changes i.e. key presses and key releases. By default, it only reports when a key is down.

UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.title: Keyboard Report Key Down Only
UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.description: This value causes ux_host_class_hid_keyboard_key_get to only report key changes i.e. key presses and key releases. By default, it only reports when a key is down.

UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.title: Keyboard Report Lock Keys
UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.description: This value causes ux_host_class_hid_keyboard_key_get to report lock key (CapsLock/NumLock/ScrollLock) changes.

UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.title: Keyboard Report Modifier Keys
UX_HOST_CLASS_HID_KEYBOARD_EVENTS_KEY_CH.description: This value causes ux_host_class_hid_keyboard_key_get to report modifier key (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/GUI) changes.

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_MEMORY_BUFFER_SIZE.description: This value represents the maximum number of bytes that a storage payload can send/receive.

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.title: Storage Thread Stack Size
UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.description: USBX Mass Storage Thread Stack Size.

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_THREAD_PRIORITY_CL.title: Storage Priority Thread
UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_THREAD_PRIORITY_CL.description: This value represents the priority of storage class thread

UX_MAX_HOST_LUN.title: Max Host LUN
UX_MAX_HOST_LUN.description: This value represents the maximum number of SCSI logical units represented in the host storage class driver.

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_MAX_MEDIA.title: Max Storage Media
UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_MAX_MEDIA.description: This value represents the maximum number of media for the host storage class.

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_INCLUDE_LEGACY_PRO.title: Include Legacy Protocol Support
UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_INCLUDE_LEGACY_PRO.description: This value includes code to handle storage devices that use the CB or CBI protocol (such as floppy disks).

UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_MAX_TRANSFER_SIZE.title: Max Transfer Size
UX_HOST_CLASS_STORAGE_MAX_TRANSFER_SIZE.description: This value represents the maximum size of single transfers for the SCSI data phase.

UX_MAX_ROOTHUB_PORT.title: Max Root Hub Port
UX_MAX_ROOTHUB_PORT.description: Define USBX max root hub port (1 ~ n).

UX_HOST_ENUM_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.description: Value of the memory allocated for a thread's enum in the USBX system.
UX_HOST_ENUM_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.title: Enum Thread Stack Size

UX_HOST_HCD_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.description: Value of the memory allocated for the Host Controller Driver (HCD) thread's stack in the USBX system.
UX_HOST_HCD_THREAD_STACK_SIZE.title: HCD Thread Stack Size

UX_HOST_HNP_POLLING_THREAD_STACK.description: Value of the memory allocated for the stack of the Host Negotiation Protocol (HNP) polling thread in the USBX system.
UX_HOST_HNP_POLLING_THREAD_STACK.title: HNP Polling Thread Stack

UX_MAX_HCD.description: This value represents the number of different host controllers available in the system. For USB 1.1 support, this value will usually be 1. For USB 2.0 support, this value can be more than 1. This value represents the number of concurrent host controllers running at the same time. If for instance there are two instances of OHCI running, or one EHCI and one OHCI controller running, the UX_MAX_HCD should be set to 2.
UX_MAX_HCD.title: Max Host Controllers

UX_HOST_SIDE_ONLY.title: Host Side Only
UX_HOST_SIDE_ONLY.description: This value will only enable the host side of USBX.

UX_ENABLE_ASSERT.title: Enable Assert
UX_ENABLE_ASSERT.description: Defined, this enables the assert checks inside USBX.

UX_THREAD_PRIORITY_HCD.title: HCD Thread Priority
UX_THREAD_PRIORITY_HCD.description: This is the Thread priority value for the host controller thread.

UX_MAX_CLASSES.title: Max Classes
UX_MAX_CLASSES.description: This value is the maximum number of classes that can be loaded by USBX. This value represents the class container and not the number of instances of a class.

UX_MAX_TT.title: Max Transaction Translators
UX_MAX_TT.description: Defines the maximum number of Transaction Translators (TT) supported in USBX, managing data transfers in USB hubs.

UX_HOST_DEVICE_CLASS_CODE_VALIDATION_ENA.title: Host Device Class Code Validation Enable
UX_HOST_DEVICE_CLASS_CODE_VALIDATION_ENA.description: Enables host device class code validation.

UX_MAX_DEVICES.title: Max Devices
UX_MAX_DEVICES.description: This value represents the maximum number of devices that can be attached to the USB. Normally, the theoretical maximum number on a single USB is 127 devices. This value can be scaled down to conserve memory. Note that this value represents the total number of devices regardless of the number of USB buses in the system.

UX_MAX_ED.description: This value represents the maximum number of EDs in the controller pool. This number is assigned to one controller only. If multiple instances of controllers are present, this value is used by each individual controller.
UX_MAX_ED.title: Max Endpoint Descriptors

UX_MAX_TD.description: This value represents the maximum number of regular and isochronous TDs in the controller pool. This number is assigned to one controller only. If multiple instances of controllers are present, this value is used by each individual controller.
UX_MAX_TD.title: Max Transfer Descriptors

UX_MAX_ISO_TD.description: This value represents the maximum number of regular and isochronous TDs in the controller pool. This number is assigned to one controller only. If multiple instances of controllers are present, this value is used by each individual controller.
UX_MAX_ISO_TD.title: Max Isochronous Transfer Descriptors

USBX_System_Stack_Size.description: Default pool size for USBX stack.
USBX_System_Stack_Size.title: USBX System Stack Size
